items.title: Your Nightly Rollup Job Is a Query That Got Too Big
'We Ported the Original Doom to SQL'
Apply to attend with 25% off: SUPAWEEKLY
From zero to NanoClaw
items.blurb: Gavriel Cohen, creator of NanoClaw and co-founder of NanoCo, joins Adam to explain how a 40-hour weekend project became a viral open source hit and the foundation of an enterprise AI company.

items.title: Olson and Söderqvist Discuss Valkey’s Evolution and Future Past Caching Use Cases at OSS EU
items.blurb: Valkey is a growing project, launched as a fork of Redis over two years ago, supported by twelve maintainers and nine committee members from various companies.

items.title: Grab Redesigns Counter Service Storage for 50% Lower P99 Latency
items.blurb: Grab migrated its high-volume Counter Service from a wide column database to Aerospike using storage abstraction, shadow traffic, data parity validation, and gradual traffic migration.

items.title: Article: Building a Session-Ordered Kafka Pipeline in Go
items.blurb: The article describes a custom implementation that provides a session-level ordering on top of Apache Kafka partitions, supporting strict message ordering across 1000s of independent channels.
